entities.summary: Masina Empire, a political institution in Mali during Post-Songhai Successor States (1818–1862). Grew from Masina Jihad 1818 and Bambara Kingdoms of Ségou and Kaarta. Led to the emergence of Fulani Jihad State of Masina.
